_notes: Solid things the ball bounces off. shape = 'box' (size = [width, length, height] in metres) or 'cylinder' (radius, height), standing on the ground. A hole can override the size. restitution = how much speed a side hit keeps straight back off the obstacle (0 = dead, 1 = perfect bounce). grip = how much sideways speed a side hit keeps. The ball can also land ON an obstacle: roll / bounce / lie_power / lie_sweet_spot then work like a surface (see surfaces.json). parts (boxes only) = several boxes making one object, as fractions of its size; offset = [across, along] as fractions too. taper = draw a cylinder as a cone. To add an obstacle type, add an entry here and use it in a hole file.
